event_family.vegas: ITC Vegas (InsureTech Connect), annual since Oct 2016; Mandalay Bay since 2021. 2021 Oct 4-6 (277 exh.), 2022 Sep 20-22 (~470 exh.), 2023 Oct 31-Nov 2 (682), 2024 Oct 15-17 (724), 2025 Oct 14-16 (762), 2026 Sep 29-Oct 1 (626 listed as of Sep 22 2026; organizer claims 600+).
event_family.asia: ITC Asia, Singapore (Sands Expo), annual since Jun 2022; ~100+ exhibitors/edition; 2026: Jun 30-Jul 2.
event_family.europe: ITC DIA Europe (ITC x Digital Insurance Agenda merger): Barcelona Jun 2023, Amsterdam Jun 2024, Barcelona 2025; renamed ITC Europe; 2026: Barcelona May 28-29 (~650 attendees, 50 exhibitors); 2027: Jun 16-17.
event_family.japan: ITC Japan, Tokyo, first edition Feb 25-26 2026 (~158 attending companies).
event_family.note: No 'ITC NY' exists; InsurTech NY is an unrelated organization. LatAm / Agents+Brokers / L&H are tracks within ITC Vegas, not separate expos.
